title: Wso2am: Netty is a network application framework for development of protocol servers and clients (CVE-2026-56746)
description: A security vulnerability (CVE-2026-56746) affects the wso2am package, which uses Netty, a network application framework for protocol servers and clients. The flaw impacts versions prior to 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.5, indicating a medium severity level. It does not affect confidentiality but can impact integrity without requiring privileges, though user interaction is needed. No known exploits are reported in the wild. Patches are available in versions 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4.
